title: Last-Mile Logistics Optimization
thesis: Snowflake optimizes last-mile delivery across 17,000 islands — Dynamic Tables maintain real-time fleet visibility, ML.FORECAST projects volume by hub, and Cortex AI generates route optimization recommendations for Indonesia's unique archipelago geography

talking_points: 30 million deliveries per month across 500 hubs and 17,000 islands.
On-time delivery rate at 91.3% — target is 95%. Cost per parcel: Rp 8,200.
Three hubs in Greater Jakarta approaching capacity — overflow risk during peak.
show: Point at 30M deliveries and 91.3% OTD rate
tabs.call_out: 91.3% OTD vs 95% target — 3 Jakarta hubs at capacity risk

transition.line: Let's look at which routes are dragging performance down.

talking_points: 50,000 routes analyzed — inter-island routes 3.2x more expensive per parcel.
Java last-mile achieving Rp 5,800/parcel; Eastern Indonesia at Rp 14,200.
ML identifies 1,200 routes where consolidation could reduce cost by 18%.
show: Show cost per parcel by region map
tabs.call_out: Eastern Indonesia 2.4x Java cost — 1,200 routes ripe for consolidation

transition.line: Route optimization is the key lever. Let's check volume forecast.

talking_points: ML.FORECAST projects 48M deliveries during Harbolnas week — 60% above baseline.
Hub capacity planning shows 12 hubs need temporary overflow capacity.
Driver scheduling optimized: 2,000 additional drivers needed for peak coverage.
show: Show volume forecast chart with Harbolnas spike
tabs.call_out: ML projects 48M Harbolnas deliveries — 12 hubs need overflow capacity

transition.line: Now let the VP ask about operations.

talking_points: Rudi asks: 'What's our on-time delivery rate this week?'
Cortex Analyst queries performance — returns 91.3%, with 3 hubs below 85%.
Follow-up: 'Generate a rebalancing plan for the 3 underperforming hubs' — AI produces plan.
show: Switch to advisory mode for plan
tabs.call_out: Two AI modes: operations analytics + logistics advisory

transition.line: Every capability — native Snowflake SQL, native ML.

talking_points: Six Snowflake capabilities, six AWS services.
Indonesia: 17,000 islands, 270M population — the world's hardest last-mile problem.
Logistics costs 23% of GDP vs 8% in developed markets.
show: Point at real-time GPS data flow
tabs.call_out: One platform, real-time fleet tracking, native ML for volume forecasting

transition.line: That's Snowflake and AWS — better together for archipelago logistics.
